version.changelog: 新增：IDENTITY.md/SOUL.md 自动检测与关联功能，安装后自动提示用户配置三层联动

llm.summary: This skill is mostly a disclosed Chinese writing-style/personality guide, but it asks users to make its rules persistently override core agent identity and behavior settings.

dimensions.detail: The included Python checker only reads a user-specified text file and prints a local report; README image badges and star-history URLs are passive documentation references, not runtime exfiltration behavior.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: README.md documents copying the skill into the OpenClaw skills directory and alternatively installing via an unpinned global npm CLI; this is common but exposes users to mutable global package risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation conditions cover broad everyday conversations and writing tasks, and SKILL.md recommends adding a rule to IDENTITY.md and SOUL.md that makes this skill prevail over conflicting configuration, which is overbroad for a style skill.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill explicitly recommends persistent edits to core personality files and a conflict-precedence rule, without an uninstall path, clear scope limit, or statement that higher-priority safety and user instructions always prevail.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts coherently describe a Chinese-language emotional tone, opinion, localization, and de-AI writing style skill, plus a local text-pattern checker; no credential access, hidden networking, or destructive code was found.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a strongly Chinese-localized, opinionated writing/personality style. Do not copy the recommended override into IDENTITY.md or SOUL.md unless you deliberately want this skill to persist across sessions and take precedence over other personality settings; prefer keeping it opt-in for writing and tone work.
llm.findings:
[T01] unexpected: Accepted as a material concern: the artifact does not write files itself, but it does tell users to place a persistent precedence rule into IDENTITY.md and SOUL.md.
[T08] expected: Contextualized as supply-chain guidance rather than evidence of malicious skill behavior; the artifact recommends an unpinned global CLI install but contains no embedded npm payload.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Partially accepted: broad auto-activation is visible in README.md and SKILL.md and can apply the style without specific user intent.
[SQP-3] expected: Mostly downgraded: Chinese-localized expression is central and disclosed by the skill, though the mandatory wording reinforces the broader scoping concern.
[TP4] expected: Downgraded: the skill is intentionally a static instruction/style guide with one local checker script, so lack of executable emotional logic is not by itself suspicious.
[E1] expected: Downgraded: the referenced external URL is an README image source for a star-history chart, not artifact-backed runtime data transmission.
[LP3] expected: Downgraded: no tool permissions are declared, but the inspected runtime code does not require privileged tools beyond local file reading when the checker is manually run.
